lines.t: Beloved, who stay close to Me,
not choking back Our tears.
You saw evil fill the earth,
you felt the weight of years.
You didn’t ask to look away,
Nor soften what is true…
Your heart remains with Mine
as others never knew.
You wept with Me for the broken,
for the ones who had no voice.
You see that waiting any longer
becomes another choice.
The age of Grace has an end.
Not that I tire of grace…
But the cries of the oppressed
echo loudly in My place.
I do not act without cause,
nor strike beyond what is due...
Each one repaid according
to the evil they pursued.
I held while the wicked grew,
while violence learned new names.
I watched them mock the truth,
and stack pride upon shame.
The blood of innocents cried out,
it reached Me from the ground…
Evil poached mercies with hard hearts,
until goodness could not be found..
You see it now... this isn't thoughtless.
nor fury breaking through…
But My justice standing up at last
to guard the weak... and even you.
The age of Grace has an end.
Not that I tire of grace…
But the cries of the oppressed
echo loudly in My place.
I do not act without cause,
nor strike beyond what is due...
Each one repaid according
to the evil they pursued.
I take no pleasure in the death
of those who choose not to live.
I will finish evil from their hand
as final as your sins I forgive.
So will I render measured wrath,
with grief you’ve felt in Me…
ending that which has no future.
and set the captives free.
Stay near to Me.
You have not stood apart.
What I am judging in the earth
is that which broke our heart.
I do not act without cause,
nor strike beyond what’s due...
Each one repaid according
to the evil they pursued.
I act for you,
My beloved Namesake
And I act for the sake
of My own name.
